Name: Juicy Fruit Trees
Author: kiyomikhaos
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][center][size=4]Grow fruit trees anywhere with no spacing limits, instant 2-day growth, and guaranteed iridium-quality harvests.
Perfect for orchard builds, greenhouse farms, and aesthetic layouts.[/size][u]

[/u]

[b][size=4]🌿 Perfect For Players Who:


[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3][b]Love decorating their farm[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][*][size=3][b]Want dense orchards[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][*][size=3][b]Start new saves often[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][*][size=3][b]Prefer convenience mods[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]
[/b][/size][*][size=3][b]Want faster progression without cheats[/b][/size]
[/list]

[size=3][b]You can have a Juicy Harvest of Fruit Trees that will always produce iridium-quality fruit!

[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]🍓 Features[/size]
[size=3]
🌳 Fruit trees grow with no 8×8 clear space required
[/size][/b][size=3]
[b]🌳 Trees can be planted freely on your Farm and in the Greenhouse
[/b]
[b]🌳 Trees reach full maturity in just 2 days
[/b]
[b]🌳 Always produces iridium-quality fruit
[/b]
[b]🌳 Perfect for decorative orchards or high-yield farms
[/b]
Create the juicy orchard of your dreams anywhere you like! ✨

[/size]
[b]
[/b][line][size=4][b]🍑 Growth Behavior[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Fruit trees will:
[/size]
[size=3][b]✅ Grow to full maturity in 2 days
[/b]
[b]✅ Grow even when placed next to objects or decorations[/b]

[b]✅ Produce consistent iridium-quality fruit
[/b]
You can plant trees close together for dense orchards or aesthetic designs without worrying about spacing rules.[/size]



[size=4][u]⚠️ [b]Seasonal restrictions still apply in the current version.

[/b][/u][/size][size=3][b]Example:[/b] [b]﻿Apple Trees planted in Spring will fully mature quickly but will only produce apples during Fall.

[/b]
[/size]
[size=4][b]🌈 Planned Features[/b]

[/size][size=3]✨ Fruit trees producing fruit in [b]all seasons[/b]
✨ Ability to place fruit trees [b]anywhere in Stardew Valley[/b][/size][size=3](This feature is planned for a future update!)
[/size][i]

[b]
[/b][/i][size=4][b]💬 About This Mod[/b]

[/size][size=3]This is my [b]first Stardew Valley mod[/b]![/size][size=3]While I have coding experience, modding Stardew was new territory for me. I originally wanted a working version of [i]Better Fruit Trees[/i] by catCattycat, but since it is currently outdated, I decided to create my own solution.[/size][size=3]It worked beautifully, so I wanted to share it with anyone else looking for the same experience.


[/size][i][size=5][b][u]This mod is my original work and available on [/u][/b][url=https://github.com/Kiyo-io/Kiyomi-s-Juicy-Harvest][b][u]GitHub
[/u][/b][/url]﻿
[/size][b]
